summary: The candidate's new paged regression models a direct mutable-view free that neither real paged cache_unfinished_req path performs. Independent CPU and assigned-GPU runs against the exact candidate behavior and prepared base showed correct ownership through both Python and native C++ paths even when _copy_for_free_group was replaced by identity. Existing abort/retract lifecycle tests pass. The reported QSA/SM121 model-serving corruption could not be reproduced in this environment, so no speculative source correction was made.

tests.what_was_measured: The candidate's synthetic paged direct-view test and existing token allocator test both pass; the candidate diff was then removed from the delivery branch.

Both actual cache_unfinished_req implementations freed the duplicate request page, retained the canonical tree page, rebound the request row, and returned canonical indices on lookup with and without the allocator clone.
On AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950, both real paths retained correct page ownership with the candidate's claimed dependency disabled.
23 tests and 2 subtests passed, covering deferred chunked-abort state handling and pause/retract scheduler transitions; these are lifecycle tests, not QSA payload tests.
The prepared base's valid generic grouped-free ownership regression passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: Real Python and native C++ radix ownership checks ran on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, under Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Both reported request_page_freed=true, tree_page_freed=false, row_is_tree=true, and match_is_tree=true with the clone disabled.

remaining_limitations: The available architecture is AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 under ROCm 7.2, not the reported DGX Spark GB10/SM121 CUDA architecture.
RadixArk/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-NVFP4 weights, NVFP4 KV cache, QSA KDA kernel configuration, EAGLE speculative decoding, 262144-token pressure, and the original stochastic timing were unavailable.
No available evidence reproduces corrupted payload through QSATokenToKVPool, repeated bad first-token output, token 248319, or cache-flush recovery.

The scheduler lifecycle tests use controlled requests and verify abort/retract transitions, while the real-cache tests verify ownership. An end-to-end test combining the reported model, QSA pool payload, chunked prefill, and a live abort/retract remains unexecuted.

No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable. The exercised extension was /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-dca03528cf46/cache/torch_extensions/py312_rocm7226015/radix_tree_cpp/radix_tree_cpp.so built from the checkout-local cpp_radix_tree sources.
